latest_features: ShulkDub's imitate mode now sends a legacy inventory transaction flow that lines up with Nukkit's crafting path instead of only emitting a modern ItemStackRequest craft packet
ShulkDub now stages the shulker and dye as real legacy crafting ingredients and derives the dyed output stack from the selected dye before sending the transaction
ShulkDub now reserves an empty inventory slot for the imitated craft result so the DUB action no longer falls back to overwriting one of the source slots
